select distinct j."if_octets" as Total,
        CASE WHEN d.application_name is NULL THEN 'App Not Found' ELSE  d.application_name END application_name,
    case
        when 'if_octets' = 'if_octets' then 'decbytes' 
        when 'if_octets' = 'if_packets' then 'prepackets'
        else 'sishort'
    end as Unit     
from (
     
  select distinct  
           cast("11/value" as double) + cast("14/value" as double)  if_octets ,
          cast("10/value" as double) + cast("13/value" as double) if_packets,
          "11/4/key" application_id
        FROM TABLE(
      quickwit.system.raw_query(
      "query" => '*',
      "qwindex" =>'flows3',
      "columns" => '11/value,14/value,10/value,13/value,11/4/key',
      "replacefromcolumns" => '/3/buckets/4/buckets/',
      "hasjs" => 'true',
      "start_timestamp" => '1778783640',
      "end_timestamp" => '1778787240',
      "aggs" => '[
                    histogram(id=3, field=span_start_timestamp_nanos, interval=144h),
                    terms(id=4, field=span_attributes.n, size=5, min=1, order=id:10:desc),
                    sum(id=10, field=span_attributes.u),
                    sum(id=11, field=span_attributes.t),
                    sum(id=13, field=span_attributes.ab),
                    sum(id=14, field=span_attributes.ac),
                    count(id=12, field=span_attributes.u)
                  ]'
      )) as i
      where "11/value"  is not null
  -- select  distinct  cast("/value" as double) + cast("4/value" as double)  if_octets ,
  --         cast("1/value" as double) + cast("3/value" as double) if_packets,
  --         "/4/key" application_id
  --       from quickwit.metrics4."" as i
) as j
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        json_extract_scalar(app_elem, '$.id')  AS application_id,
        json_extract_scalar(app_elem, '$.name') AS application_name
    FROM tenant.public.temp_obj t
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CAST(json_extract(t.object_value, '$.application') AS ARRAY(JSON))) AS t_unnested(app_elem)
    WHERE t.obj_type = 'APPLICATION'
) d ON j.application_id = d.application_id  
order by  1 desc
limit 5
